name: Focus mode
author: Daniel Killenberger
description: Plugin-owned distraction list with exclusive windows, always-on off-space site block, and a conscious-choice intercept banner. Focus mode locks the space, mutes those apps while focused, and shows one grouped count after you leave.

barWidget.description: Owned distraction list, always-on off-space site block, and intercept banner. Focus mode locks the space, mutes its notifications, and shows a grouped count after you leave.
